summary.title: Sorry, you have been blocked (Medium profile of Jim Medlock)
summary.one_liner: Unknown: the page is a Cloudflare security block screen, so no article content could be read from this Medium profile URL.
takeaways: The Medium profile page could not be read because a Cloudflare security block was shown.
The block was triggered by the site's security service, which can fire on certain words, phrases, SQL-like commands or malformed data.
The block page asks visitors to contact the site owner and include the Cloudflare Ray ID.
No articles, topics or tutorial content from this author can be confirmed from this page.
summary.summary: This page is a Cloudflare security block screen that appeared instead of the Medium profile for Jim Medlock (jdmedlock). The text explains that the security service was triggered by the visitor's action, such as a certain word or phrase, a SQL command or malformed data, and suggests emailing the site owner with the Ray ID. The page contains no article text, so what Jim Medlock writes about cannot be determined from it. The listing in florinpop17/app-ideas only identifies him as a main contributor with a Twitter link and articles.
